verify_detail: median — the other four runs cluster tightly around 2530–2560 ms.\n\nNote on methodology: no raw shell/adb access was available, so timing was measured via Maestro\'s JS engine (`Date.now()`) bracketing the launch, with the end marker triggered by the "Ping" button becoming visible in the UI hierarchy — this is a UI-visible proxy for cold start rather than the `am start -W` `TotalTime` metric, so it includes a small amount of Maestro polling/dispatch overhead on top of true process-start time.'
